subject: Transition plan: Hosted→Dedicated — scaling runway, validation gates, and cutover agenda
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily@stride.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted→Dedicated transition — capacity profile & validation asks

Hi Aditya / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Before we lock dates with procurement and infra, I need a succinct plan we can circulate internally that covers:

- Sizing assumptions (peak RPS, avg token/sec, concurrency targets) and margin used for the initial reserved pool
- Validation gates we will run in staging and production canary (KPIs with numeric thresholds for pass/fail: p50/p95 latency, 99th token time, error rate, qps headroom)
- Warmup strategy (KV/prefix cache priming, synthetic traffic vs mirrored traffic and expected warmup duration)
- Cutover cadence (blackout windows, canary slices %, rollback signals and estimated RTO)
- Post-cutover monitoring and escalation path (who we call for SLA breaches)

I've attached our traffic profile and the latest token-volume export. Can you provide a short timeline and the exact artifacts we'll need to show to our procurement/security reviewers? Also confirm if your team will require a separate private VPC/peering step prior to the swap.

Goal: we want a one-page runbook + a 5-step acceptance checklist we can attach to the PO.

Thanks,
Emily

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Hosted→Dedicated transition — capacity profile & validation asks

Emily — thanks for the clear list. Drafting a concise runbook and checklist now; key points below (we'll attach the CSV/XLS for numbers):

1) Sizing assumptions (initial reserved pool)
   - Traffic baseline: 18k qps peak across 4 model routes (derived from your April export).
   - Token mix: avg 32 tokens/request, burst tail to 120 tokens.
   - Concurrency target: 2,400 concurrent requests (sustained peak), plus 20% buffer for sudden bursts -> initial pool sized for 2,880 concurrency equivalents.
   - GPU footprint: will map to 64x A10G-equivalents (logical units). We recommend starting with 72 units (25% runway) for the first 7 days.

2) Validation gates (pass/fail criteria to sign off each stage)
   - Staging smoke (pre-cutover): p95 latency <= 550ms, request error rate < 0.5% over 1h load test, KV cache hit >= 70% after warmup.
   - Canary (prod slice, 5% traffic): p95 latency within 1.2x hosted baseline, p99 token time < 2s, end-to-end error rate < 1% across 24h.
   - Scale stress (50% synthetic burst): no more than 10% increase in p95 latency, no unmapped OOMs, queue length < 50 requests.

3) Warmup strategy
   - Phase A (staging priming): replay ~48h of anonymized traffic against staging (synthetic mirror) to prepopulate KV caches; expected warmup 90–120 minutes to reach 70% hit.
   - Phase B (canary priming): route mirroring for 6 hours prior to cutting canary; active prefix priming for high-frequency keys.

4) Cutover cadence and rollback signals
   - Pre-cutover: 48h staging cert, 12h mirror, DocuSign + procurement confirmed.
   - Day 0 (cutover window): 02:00–06:00 PT blackout for heavy config changes; canary at 5% for 2h → expand to 20% for 4h if gates pass → 100% over rolling stages (1h per weight) if stable.
   - Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 2x baseline for 15m, error rate > 3% for 10m, OOMs on >2 hosts in 30m. Estimated RTO: 30–60 minutes.

5) Post-cutover ops
   - 0–6h: elevated monitoring with on-call: Marissa (primary), Karthik (infra lead), Monica (ops escalation).
   - 24–72h: watch window with daily readout and KPI digest to Stride infra.

Deliverables we'll attach:
   - One-page runbook (handoff-agenda.pdf)
   - Sizing table & assumptions (sizing-assumptions-v2.csv)
   - Acceptance checklist (embedded in runbook)

Questions for you:
- Do you require a pre-cutover VPC peering/network window? If yes, we need CIDR confirmations and whitelisting 72h in advance.
- Can procurement accept our 72-unit initial reservation with a 30-day rightsize clause?

I'll produce the one-pager and checklist by EOD and drop the sheets into the HubSpot deal link.

Thanks — will schedule a 30m alignment call for the timeline once you confirm the peering ask.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao

Tom — appreciate the PO and the ask to accelerate. We're able to shift the timeline to accommodate an Apr 30 cutover but with tightened pre-cutover windows; summary below and next steps:

Revised timeline (compressed):
- 2028-04-27: final staging smoke + 6h mirror run (team signoff by 18:00 PT)
- 2028-04-28: deliver runbook + DocuSign package to Stride procurement (we'll publish links)
- 2028-04-29: dry-run rollback rehearsal (internal) + security gets SOC2 bundle and 7-day audit log link (we will provide S3 presigned URLs)
- 2028-04-30 (Cutover day): 02:00–06:00 PT maintenance window; canary 5% → 20% → roll per acceptance gates

Acceptance gates: all staging checks must be green by 04/27 18:00 PT; if any gate fails we will reschedule to May 3 (next available window).

Operational notes:
- Security bundle: Monica will DM the SOC2 evidence portal link and generate the 7-day audit export by 04/29 EOD.
- VPC/peering: please confirm CIDRs by 04/24 12:00 PT. Without peering we can still cutover but will use TLS-only public endpoints (longer blackout risk).
- On-call: Marissa (primary), Karthik (infra), Aditya (sales escalation).

DocuSign & procurement: I'll push the DocuSign room (Room-89012) and the HubSpot deal will include the acceptance checklist and the sizing CSV. Please confirm PO# STR-4521 acceptance.

I'll set a 30m call for 04/24 10:00 PT to walk the checklist and CIDR asks — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Stride onto a dedicated pool with a safe roll.

Best,
